sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release, Barrier

system.description:
You weave together a wall of shimmering, blocks of sealing symbols in the form of blocks on a solid surface within range. You can make a straight wall up to 30 feet long, 20-feet higher and 1 feet thick, or a cylindrical wall up to 20-feet high, 1 foot thick and 20 feet in diameter. This wall can be seen through as if looking through a foggy glass window.

This wall cannot be climbed, walked on and acts like a solid barrier that repels organic creatures.

Ranged Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu and Weapon attacks or Ninjutsu with a special shape that attempts to pass through the barrier or attempts to originate within the barrier is turned back on its caster, making its target the original caster, using the casters original attack vs their own AC. Genjutsu cast targeting a creature on the opposite side does not get redirected back to its original caster.

This barrier, while powerful, is extremely draining, the cost to maintain this jutsu, is its original cost to cast it.
